items.title: How John Ternus understood the assignment in the Apple launch event opener
items.summary: Newly minted Apple (AAPL) CEO John Ternus took the spotlight in the cinematic opener at the company's latest launch event, his predecessor Tim Cook handing the torch off in front of the audience. Creative Strategies CEO and principal analyst Ben Bajarin comes on Market Domination to talk about Ternus' presentation and how he represented Apple's core ideals.

items.title: Foldable iPhone Duo's software helps it 'shine' against competitors
items.summary: Apple's (AAPL) new CEO John Ternus unveiled the tech company's latest product — the foldable iPhone Duo — at a launch event on Wednesday. Creative Strategies CEO and principal analyst Ben Bajarin shares his perspective on the Duo's software features that help it stand out and how much of the market share it could take from other foldable phones.

items.title: Apple reveals the foldable iPhone Duo
items.summary: Apple (AAPL) debuted its first foldable iPhone, named iPhone Duo, with a passport-like design and a starting price of $1,999. The Duo's front has a 5.4-inch display, which can be folded open to a 7.6-inch display.

items.title: Here's the competition Apple’s foldable iPhone faces
items.summary: Yahoo Finance Technology Editor Dan Howley joins Market Catalyst host Julie Hyman to talk about the foldable smartphone market ahead of Apple's (AAPL) product launch and how it will have to contend with Samsung and Huawei's foldable offerings.

items.title: John Ternus's biggest challenges as Apple's new CEO
items.summary: Apple's (AAPL) new CEO John Ternus takes center stage today at the company's annual fall event at its Cupertino, Calif., headquarters.
